question: Should the fallback GitHub App token retain `contents: read` after a controlled failure-path run confirms whether label-routing configuration must be read under that token?
rationale: The code change crosses a credential-permission boundary, and the required fallback behavior is conditional; a maintainer must confirm the intended operational and least-privilege contract after evidence is available.

options.title: Require fallback-path proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs or a controlled run show the fallback token loading routing configuration and applying labels with this exact permission.

options.title: Accept the documented boundary
options.body: Approve the fallback content-read grant as an intentional repository policy after an owner reviews the action contract and accepts the residual proof gap.
